title: Pro Shop Store Credit: reinstatement fee combination rule
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers how the tier's own reinstatement charge and any corporate-enrollment surcharge combine into the single fee charged on reinstatement, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
The fee actually charged when reinstating a suspended Pro Shop Store Credit account is the tier's own standing reinstatement fee plus any corporate-enrollment surcharge that applies, added together once, and the total is rounded to two decimal places. The two figures are always added together where the surcharge applies; the surcharge is never applied in place of the tier's own fee, and neither figure is ever applied more than once.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's own standing reinstatement fee is 15.00 USD, and the member's corporate wellness enrollment is currently suspended for the employer's nonpayment, carrying a late-payment fee of 20.00 USD. The fee charged on this reinstatement is 35.00 USD -- the two figures added together once -- not 20.00 USD alone, and not 15.00 USD alone.
